messages:
Sam: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — let's finalize owners, link JIRA tickets, and set checkpoints for the recurring DB failover and long-tail latency action items. I want ownership and a 2/6/12 week check cadence.

Priya: I can take the DB failover RCA and mitigation work. I'll create the main ticket and a couple of sub-tasks for runbook updates + test harness.

Ben: I'll own the latency regression tracking and SLO backstop (alerting + compensating controls). Need access to the historical traces.

Ola: I'll take deployment-side mitigations (rate-limits, graceful drain) and the rollback checklist. Can make deployment playbook a dependent task.

ops-bot: JIRA created: RINF-3500 — "DB failover: investigate repeating primary promotions" assigned to Priya. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-3500

Priya: Created subtasks RINF-3500-1 (runbook edit) and RINF-3500-2 (replay tests). Tagging @Ben for latency correlation.

Ben: Thanks — will export traces and link RINF-3501 (latency alerts/dashboards). I'll propose draft thresholds by Tue.

Sam: Proposed RACI for these items:
- Responsible (R): Priya (DB RCA), Ben (latency metrics)
- Accountable (A): Sam (remediation delivery)
- Consulted (C): Ola, Infra Eng
- Informed (I): Eng-oncall, Product, Support
If no objections, I'll lock it in.

Ola: OK with that. Can we make RINF-3500 blocked-by RINF-3501 for telemetry verification? Need certainty before changing runbook.

Priya: Agree — set blocked-by RINF-3501. I'll add a checklist item: "validate primary promotion rate with telemetry".

Ben: Draft alert idea: composite of promotion count > 1 per 30m AND p95 latency > 800ms for 10m. Will post exact query and noise-mitigation plan.

Sam: Checkpoints: 48h triage update, 2-week remediation delivery for initial runbook + mitigations, 6-week automation and test harness, 12-week retrospective to validate recurrence. Add calendar invites.

Priya: I'll add a recurring item to the postmortem doc: 2w/6w/12w status rows and owners.

ops-bot: Subtask created: RINF-3500-1 "runbook edits + emergency promotion steps" assigned to Priya.

Ola: For rollback checklist, quick preflight suggestions:
```
- confirm binary compatibility for last 3 releases
- verify config flags for connection backoff
- dry-run rollback on staging canary
```
I'll attach this to RINF-3502 (deployment playbook).

Ben: I'll upload the trace export and link RINF-3501. Also adding a dashboard with historical promotion spikes.

Sam: Ownership summary: RINF-3500 (DB failover) — Priya (R), RINF-3501 (telemetry/alerts) — Ben (R), RINF-3502 (deploy mitigations/playbook) — Ola (C). Sam (A) across items.

Priya: ETA: runbook PR + initial test plan by EOD Friday.

Ben: ETA: dashboard + draft alerts by Tue COB.

Ola: ETA: rollback checklist + staging dry-run plan in 5 business days.

Sam: Good. Please add PR/JIRA links here when available and mark me as watcher. We'll reconvene in 48 hours for triage. If blockers appear, escalate to eng-oncall.

Priya: Will update tickets and post progress here. Thanks. :white_check_mark:

Ben: Will follow up with thresholds and noise suppression notes.

Ola: I'll start drafting the playbook and ping infra for canary window.

Sam: Closing thread — open new thread if the scope changes.
